cases.name: Tina Prince
cases.about: She was a first grade elementary school teacher. "What I will miss most about her is her presence. How great she made you feel when you were around her. How loving she was. How compassionate she was about people,” her nephew Mason Evans said.
cases.narrative: Her body was found off off Pleasant Grove Road near Sandersville.
